title: On some sums involving small arithmetic functions
summary: Let $f$ be any arithmetic function and define $S_f(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f([x/n])$. If the function $f$ is small, namely, $f(n)\ll n^\varepsilon,$ then the error term $E_f(x)$ in the asymptotic formula of $S_f(x)$ has the form $O(x^{1/2+\varepsilon}).$ In this paper, we shall study the mean square of $E_f(x)$ and establish some new results of $E_f(x)$ for some special functions.
